description: The Jakarta standard for declaring validation rules as annotations that a validator enforces at run time.
An annotation such as @NotBlank, @Size or @Min that states one rule about a field, parameter or type.
The annotation that asks for a request body or nested object to be validated, including each element of a collection.
Spring's annotation that enables validation on a class or selects validation groups for one parameter.
The exception Spring MVC raises when a constraint declared directly on a controller parameter is violated.
An annotation paired with a ConstraintValidator class that enforces a rule the built-in constraints cannot express.
A marker interface that selects which constraints run, so one type can be validated differently for create and update.
